note: ch7 adversarial audit + fixes before the ch8 run

new_hazards_found.summary: a Back Extra can be copy-pasted onto a neighbouring card, where its pronouns lose their antecedent and it teaches the wrong fact
new_hazards_found.why: duplicate Back Extra across two cards is detectable, but whether the text BELONGS on a card is semantic. The near-duplicate check compares Text, not Back Extra, and widening it would fire on every legitimate shared Distinguish. Caught by editor check #11 (Back Extra earns its place) and the audit pass.

new_hazards_found.summary: a verb can presuppose its own answer — 'remain ___' admits only 'unchanged', so grammar hands over a forced-choice blank
new_hazards_found.why: requires judging which completions are idiomatic, which is exactly the cold-solve test the LLM judge owns (editor #18). No regex distinguishes 'remain unchanged' from 'are unchanged'.

new_hazards_found.summary: a SKILL DRILL is a multi-page procedure that three separate stages each treated as a single plate, indexing 1 of 12 on Chapter 8
the extractor appends exactly one page after a caption, which truncates a drill's steps mid-procedure
a long-running audit agent read a cards file that a parallel rebuild rewrote underneath it, so every index in its report was stale
